data.body:
FIXED — evidence.

Design chosen: AC1 option (b) recovery extension (load-bearing), option (a) reordering rejected — full rationale in the description. OSS grounding: the idempotent-replay pattern (transactional-outbox consumers, Debezium/Kafka Connect offset-resume, Temporal activity retries, Stripe idempotency keys): best-effort ordering paired with recovery that heals ANY partial-failure ordering, keyed on the deterministic inbound local id.

Implementation: binding_walk.py phase-1b L10 guard swapped one-for-one for _adopt_stands_down(): a marked key is replayed only when marker set == [deterministic adopt id] AND no binding-store entry AND no local ticket (the lost-adopt residue); every other configuration (live local ticket, pending write-ahead entry, foreign/double markers, retired keys) stands down exactly as before. compute_binding_walk_mutations complexity unchanged (ratchet: new=0 increased=0). fsck untouched (AC3): its unbound_jira audit never consulted labels, keeps alerting until the binding exists.

RED evidence (pre-fix, both new replay cells): assert [] == ['REB-3510'] — 'marked-but-unstored key must replay the adopt' (walk-level) and 'runner 2 must replay the lost adopt' (end-to-end two-runner) — exactly the stand-down. The 3 stand-down guard cells passed pre-fix. Post-fix: 24 targeted tests green; full reconciler suite 3186 passed; make lint + make typecheck (mypy 639 files) green. The d103 absence oracle (test_reconcile_once.py) updated: pass 1 now heals the residue, so pass 2's bound off-window probe is answered deterministically with the 404 sentinel — oracles (no create, zero mutations) unchanged.

Landed: Gerrit change 2152 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted), merged as a4886b03fc8cbb5a68cc09328bbb837051850ae7 (commit 'Replay lost adopts instead of standing down', rebar-ticket trailer 2392-9389-39f9-4ca6).

caused_by attribution: commit 20dd2fb21e ('feat(reconciler): level-triggered ADOPT heals drift class B', rebar-ticket: 5854-b8d4-17be-4bb2) introduced both the adopt path (label stamped in-pass before durable publish, via the reused inbound-create leaf) and the L10 label stand-down whose comment promised 'binding recovery owns re-linking a marked-but-unstored key' — a promise nothing fulfilled until this fix. Closing with --caused-by=5854-b8d4-17be-4bb2.
